description:
Findo is a GPS location tracker, family locator, and family tracker designed to help you stay connected with the people who matter most. Whether you want to find friends, keep up with family members, or make sure they arrive safely, Findo gives you real-time location sharing in one simple app. Trusted by over 12 million users worldwide, Findo helps families, friends, and close circles share live GPS locations, receive smart place alerts, check battery levels, and send emergency alerts. 

With Findo, you can:
• Find friends instantly: View the real-time position of your friends on a private, secure map.
• Utilize the family tracker features: Set smart alerts to get notified when someone arrives, leaves, or needs help.
• Rely on a secure family locator: Separate family, friends, and coworkers with full control over who sees your live location data.
• Get started without signup: No registration required—it's perfect for emergencies, quick meetups, or daily tracking.
• Track locations without draining your battery: Our advanced technology helps provide accurate location updates while minimizing battery usage.

Here’s what you’ll get:
REAL-TIME GPS LOCATION SHARING
Always know your family is safe. This all-in-one family locator lets you check live GPS locations on the map, share your location with your circle, find friends, and stay connected throughout the day.

THE ULTIMATE FAMILY TRACKER
Experience greater peace of mind. This family tracker functions as a secure safety net, making it easy to check whether the kids made it to practice or your partner made it back home safely. Browse historical GPS travel data to see where your loved ones have been throughout the day.

CHAT AND FIND YOUR FRIENDS
Coordinate meetups effortlessly. This GPS location tracker allows you to see arrival times, view your friend's route, and meet up in crowded places.

SMART LOCATION ALERTS
Set designated places like school, home, or work. Findo, the family locator app, will notify you the moment a member of your circle arrives or leaves those specific locations.

EMERGENCY HELP
Need help? Tap once to send an emergency alert to every member of your private circle.

PERSONALIZED GPS MAP
Make your map feel like your own. Choose custom icons for each person, tag favorite places like Home, Work, Gym, or your go-to coffee shop, and build a GPS map that reflects your life.

Get started instantly and create your first circle in seconds. Download Findo, the GPS location tracker and family tracker that helps you find friends, keep loved ones close, and stay in the loop.

BEFORE YOU START
Findo works without an account—no signup required. Just know that without an account, your data is stored only on your current device and can't be recovered if you switch phones or delete the app.

It's also important to note that continuous use of GPS location tracking services running in the background may reduce battery life.

By using the app, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use: 
https://bpmob.com/safe24/privacy/  
https://bpmob.com/safe24/terms/
summary: Caring, not overbearing! Keep tabs on your family with our location tracker app
